headline.title: How the Pope’s Magnifica Humanitas offers a template for individuals to meet the AI moment
headline.summary: Pope Leo XIV's encyclical, "Magnifica Humanitas," emphasizes that "Technology is never neutral," urging individuals and policymakers to approach the transformative impact of artificial intelligence with courage and solidarity. The document serves as a guide for navigating the ethical implications of AI in society.

articles.title: Adobe’s conversational AI agent is a mediocre design intern
articles.summary: Adobe's new conversational AI image assistant aims to enhance the creative process for users, particularly those without design experience. However, the article critiques its effectiveness, describing it as a "mediocre design intern" that does not fully engage users in the creative workflow.

articles.title: Glean’s top line crosses $300M as AI budget-cutting becomes its major selling point
articles.summary: Glean, an enterprise AI search startup, has reported a significant increase in its annual revenue, surpassing $300 million, as it positions itself as a cost-saving solution amid budget cuts in AI spending. The company has managed to triple its revenue despite increased competition from larger tech firms entering the market.

articles.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 1): A Beginner's Guide to torch.profiler
articles.summary: This article introduces beginners to the `torch.profiler` tool in PyTorch, which is designed to help users analyze and optimize the performance of their PyTorch models. It provides a step-by-step guide on how to implement profiling in PyTorch, highlighting key features and best practices for effective performance monitoring.

articles.title: Catch up on 12 major I/O 2026 moments
articles.summary: The article highlights twelve significant moments from the I/O 2026 keynote, showcasing key announcements and developments. It features a visual representation of the event with the I/O logo and various stills from the presentation.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gets a speed boost and cleaner design
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced an updated version of Microsoft 365 Copilot featuring a cleaner design and improved loading speed, reportedly twice as fast as before. The update aims to enhance user experience by delivering more reliable and structured responses that are easier to scan, available on both desktop and mobile devices.

articles.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
articles.summary: Researchers have successfully utilized sparse autoencoders to extract interpretable features from the Claude 3 Sonnet language model, demonstrating that dictionary learning methods can scale beyond small transformers. The study involved training the autoencoders with up to 34 million features, revealing multilingual and multimodal capabilities in the model's middle layer residual stream.

articles.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
articles.summary: The article introduces AgentDoG 1.5, a new lightweight and scalable alignment framework designed to enhance the safety and security of AI agents, particularly in open-world environments. It addresses the inadequacies of current alignment frameworks in light of advanced AI models that increase safety risks and lower barriers for potential attacks.

articles.title: OmniMatBench: A Human-Calibrated Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Across 19 Materials Science Subfields
articles.summary: The article introduces OmniMatBench, a new benchmark designed for evaluating multimodal reasoning in materials science across 19 subfields. This benchmark aims to address the limitations of existing materials benchmarks by focusing on the broader reasoning processes involved in applying materials knowledge.

articles.title: Double-Edged Sword or Sharp Tool? Designing and Evaluating Triadic LLM-Teacher Collaboration for K-12 Writing at Scale
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of a triadic collaboration system involving Large Language Models (LLMs), teachers, and students to enhance K-12 writing education. It presents a multidimensional evaluation framework based on Systemic Functional Linguistics to assess the effectiveness of this integration.

articles.title: Aryabhata 2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Advanced STEM Reasoning
articles.summary: Aryabhata 2 is a new reinforcement learning model designed to enhance advanced STEM reasoning capabilities, specifically targeting competitive examinations like JEE and NEET. It aims to address the challenges of deploying large language models at scale for solving complex, multi-step problems in physics, chemistry, and mathematics.

articles.title: S3Mem: Structured Spatiotemporal Scene-Event Memory for Long-Horizon Interactive Question Answering
articles.summary: The paper introduces S3Mem, a structured spatiotemporal scene-event memory designed to enhance long-horizon interactive question answering by improving the trajectory-to-answer interface of long-term memory. It addresses the limitations of traditional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods that struggle with context length and evidence completeness in answering questions about earlier events.
